Key Responsibilities

-Manage and maintain the Zenoti platform (POS, CRM, scheduling, inventory)

-Configure system settings, user roles, and workflows

-Handle onboarding and implementation of new locations or users

-Troubleshoot system issues (bookings, payments, reports, etc.)

-Provide technical support to internal teams and clients

-Assist with system integrations (payment gateways, marketing tools, etc.)

-Generate reports and ensure data accuracy

-Train staff on proper system usage





Requirements

-Proven experience working with Zenoti (required)

-Background in IT support, system administration, or SaaS platforms

-Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

-Experience with system configuration and user management

-Experience with POS or CRM systems

-Good English communication skills (written and verbal)

-Ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks

title: Spanish Accountant
description:
We are looking for a Spanish Accounting Specialist with strong, hands-on experience in Spanish accounting practices. This role is ideal for someone who has managed full-cycle accounting across different companies and is confident handling year-end processes independently.



Key Responsibilities

-Manage full-cycle accounting for companies operating under Spanish regulations

-Perform day-to-day bookkeeping in compliance with Spanish accounting standards

-Handle year-end closing processes (preparation, adjustments, and reporting)

-Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with local requirements

-Support preparation and submission of financial statements





Core Requirements (Must-Have)

-At least 3 years of hands-on experience in Spanish accounting

-Proven experience managing full accounting cycles across different industries

-Strong experience with year-end closing processes

-Solid background in day-to-day bookkeeping under Spanish regulations

-Practical, real-world accounting experience (this is prioritized over theory)

-Fluent or native Spanish speaker

-Experience with: Legalization of accounting books

-Filing Annual Accounts with the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil)

-Familiarity with accounting tools such as A3 / A3SOC (or similar software)
